name: Posio
description: A multiplayer geography game using Websockets
readme_preview:
A multiplayer geography game built using: - [Django](https://www.djangoproject.com/) ([GeoDjango](https://docs.djangoproject.com/en/5.0/ref/contrib/gis/)) and the [Django Channels](https://channels.readthedocs.io/en/latest/) library - [HTMX](https://htmx.org/) - [Leaflet](https://leafletjs.com/)

Visit [https://posio.abrenaut.com/](https://posio.abrenaut.com/) for a live demo.
